translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: E ndalogo Hezekia nobedo matuo kendo nohewore. Janabi Isaya wuod Amoz nodhi ire mowachone niya, “Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: Los weche mag dalani maber nikech ndaloni mar tho ochopo kendo ok inichangi.”
Hezekia nolokore kongʼiyo kor ot mi olamo Jehova Nyasaye kama,
“Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, parie kaka asewuotho e nyimi gi adiera kod chuny modimbore kendo asetimo gigo makare e nyim wangʼi.” Bangʼe Hezekia noywak malit.
Eka wach Jehova Nyasaye nobiro ne Isaya kama:
“Dhi mondo inyis Hezekia ni, ‘Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Daudi kwaru wacho: Asewinjo lemoni kendo aseneno pi wangʼi; omiyo abiro medi ngima moromo higni apar gabich.
Kendo abiro resi kaachiel gi dala maduongʼni e lwet ruodh Asuria. Abiro rito dala maduongʼni.
“ ‘Ma e ranyisi ma Jehova Nyasaye nomiyi ni obiro timo gima osesingo:
Abiro dwoko tipo mar wangʼ chiengʼ manie raidhi mar dhood Ahaz ondamo apar chien.’ ” Omiyo wangʼ chiengʼ ne odok ondamo apar chien e raidhi mane oselorie.
Magi e weche mag Hezekia ruodh Juda bangʼ kane osechango e tuone:

content.text: Ne apenjora niya, “E ndalo mag ber mar ngimana,
bende onego bed ni akalo e rangeye mag tho
kendo hikena modongʼ duto gol kuoma?”
Ne awacho niya, “Ok anachak ane Jehova Nyasaye owuon,
e piny joma ngima;
bende ok anachak aket genona kuom dhano wadwa,
kata bedo gi joma koro odak e pinyni.
Osepudh oda mi owit mabor mana
kaka igolo kiru mar jakwath.
Ngimana osengʼad machiek mana kaka jatwengʼo
dolo usi mabed machiek kendo asandora pile ka pile,
odiechiengʼ kod otieno.
Aywak ka rem ohewa nyaka piny ru,
chokena otur mana ka gima sibuor ema oturo,
isanda chakre okinyi nyaka odhiambo.
Ne aywak mana ka opija kata ka ongo-wangʼ
kendo adengo mana ka akuru.
Wengena ne otho bo kane arango polo.
An gi chandruok, yaye Ruoth Nyasaye, bi iresa!”
To an dawach angʼo?
Osewuoyo koda mi en owuon osetimona ma,
abiro wuotho kadembora e ngimana duto
nikech lit manie chunya.
Yaye Ruoth Nyasaye wecheni emomiyo dhano ngima;
chunya yudo ngima kuom wecheni.
Iseduogona ngimana
mi koro iyiena mondo adagi.
Chutho chandruok duto maseyudo
okelona mana kony.
Nikech herani mogundho iseresa e kethruok;
bende isewito richona duto kadiengʼeyi.
Joma ni e liel ok nyal paki,
tho ok nyal wero wendi mar pak,
chutho joma dhi e bur ok nyal geno adiera mari.
To joma ngima,
kende ema nyalo goyoni erokamano,
mana kaka atimo kawuononi;
wuone bende nyiso nyithindgi adiera mari.
Jehova Nyasaye biro resa,
kendo wanawer wende pak gi nyiduonge,
ndalo duto mag ngimawa ei hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.

content: Isaya nowacho niya, “Swag ngʼowu kendo iwirie kama bur okuodono, to obiro chango.”
Hezekia noyudo osepenjo, “Ere gima biro bedona ranyisi ni abiro dhi e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye?”

footnotes.text: Gi dho jo-Hibrania rangeye mag tho en Sheol.
